[[File:Archadian Judges.jpg|thumb|250px|The Archadian Judges from ''[[Final Fantasy XII]]''.]]
The '''Judges''' are a recurring element in the ''[[Final Fantasy series|Final Fantasy]]'' titles that exist in the [[Ivalice]] universe. Generally, Judges are the keepers of law and have held this position since their initial appearance in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''.

==Appearances==
===''[[Final Fantasy XI]]''===
The in-game moderators, Game Masters (or GM's), appeared in the form of Judges, and were capable of using exclusive magic and abilities.

===''[[Final Fantasy XII]]''===
{{main|Archadian Judges}}
[[File:Gabranth-FFXII.png|right|90px|Judge Gabranth.]]
Judges serve under the Ministry of Law in the [[Archadia|Archadian Empire]]. The highest in rank is the Judge Magisters, who are often accompanied by subordinate [[Judge (Final Fantasy XII enemy)|Judges]]. The Judge Magisters are effectively the Empire's Supreme Court.
{{clear}}

====''[[Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings]]''====
{{main|Judge of Wings}}
[[File:Winged Judge.png|right|90px|Judge of Wings.]]
The Judge of Wings is aptly referred to as a Judge by the [[Sky pirate (Final Fantasy XII)|sky pirates]] due to her armor's resemblance to that of Archadian Judges. However, she is not affiliated with Archadia.
{{clear}}

====''[[Fortress]]''====
[[File:Fortress - FFXII Judge and Floating Rocks.jpg|thumb|150px|A mysterious Judge.]]
A Judge appears in a [[Fortress/Concept art|concept art]]. He looks suspiciously like [[Judge Gabranth|Gabranth]], although he wields a lance rather than a sword.
{{clear}}

===''[[Final Fantasy XIV]]''===
Game Masters once again take the form of Judges in both the original ''[[Final Fantasy XIV (version 1.0)|Final Fantasy XIV]]'' and ''[[Final Fantasy XIV|Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn]]''.

===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''===
[[File:Battle Judge.PNG|right|A Judge.]]
{{main|Judge (Tactics Advance)}}
The Judges' debut in the series. They serve to uphold the law set by the Ivalice Royal Family, headed by Queen [[Remedi]] and administered by Judgemaster [[Cid Randell]].
{{clear}}

====''[[Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift]]''====
[[File:Luso and Judge Artwork.jpg|thumb|150px|A Judge.]]
{{main|Judge (Tactics A2)}}
The Judges are given a different persona as well as a different role. They serve Adjudged [[Clan]]s where they protect them from death as long as they uphold the laws set during engagements.
{{clear}}

===''[[Final Fantasy Type-0]]''===

{{Main|The Rursan Arbiter}}
The Judge is a being who appears during the time of [[Tempus Finis (Type-0)|Tempus Finis]]. Located in [[Pandæmonium (Type-0)|Pandæmonium]] and it will give the "Final Judgement" to the people of [[Orience]].

===''[[Final Fantasy Explorers]]''===
Three Gartian Empire NPCs, Biggs, Wedge and Colonel Grauser, wear armor identical to the Judges of Ivalice.
